name: Chateau Barber Shop
tagline: Downtown Napa's walk-in barbershop. Precision cuts, beards, and straight-razor work, first come, first served.
seoTitle: Chateau Barber Shop | Walk-in Barber in Downtown Napa, CA
description: Chateau Barber Shop at 1521 3rd St, downtown Napa. Walk-in barbershop run by owner San Yankee since June 2005. Precision haircuts, beards, straight razor shaves. Rated 4.9 on Google, 5.0 on Yelp. (707) 255-7662.
highlights: Walk-ins only, first come first served

about.title: Twenty years of cuts and camaraderie.
body: Owner Santysouk "San" Yankee is originally from Laos, where she learned to cut and style men's hair and ran her own salon. She came to the U.S. in 2001, went to barber school in Sacramento, and opened Chateau Barber Shop at 1521 Third St., the former home of Phil's Barber Shop, in June 2005 with the support of her late husband (Napa Valley Register).

Twenty years later the shop is one of the main barbershops in Napa, with lines out the door and regulars coming from Sonoma, Vallejo and even San Francisco. The specialties are precision haircuts, beards, straight-razor shaves and line work. No appointments: walk in, grab a seat, and become part of the family.

reviews.text: People typically wait for the owner, but Andrea would always give a perfect cut, spending the time to pay close attention to detail. I like that a bald fade was truly a bald fade when coming here, some places arent willing to fully shave down to the skin when asked. This place was my go-to while living in the area and was always worth the drive for me. Miss coming here and will definitely go back when Im local.

reviews.text: San is an amazing barber always friendly and can get you feeling brand new. If you are having a bad day go get a haircut but keep the negativity at home. If busy you should wait it's worth it.

reviews.text: There's a long line, it's cash only and they have $30 haircuts; kids 10 and under, and seniors 65 and older $25. San is skilled and did an excellent job quickly.
reviews.author: Wayne G.

reviews.text: San is amazing! I’ve been coming here for 10+ years. It’s First Come First Serve but she is efficient! After the first time I came she remembered my style. She’s the best. People wait for her for a reason.

reviews.text: San is the best in the business always delivers a fresh cut. Good prices Wait time not bad. Street parking and a parking lot. Downtown Napa.

press.text: My business has grown tremendously from initially being an unknown barbershop with just myself cutting hair to being one of the main barbershops in Napa. Through excellent customer reviews and word of mouth, I have been able to grow my business into what it is today.

faq.a: No. Chateau is walk-in only, first come first served. The owner says there are sometimes lines out the door, and reviewers say the wait is worth it.
A standard haircut was $35 per the Napa Valley Register (April 2025). A 2024 Yelp review mentions $25 for kids 10 and under and seniors 65+. Call (707) 255-7662 for current prices.
Tuesday to Friday 9 AM–6 PM, Saturday 9 AM–4 PM. Closed Sunday and Monday.
There's street parking and a parking lot nearby, per a Yelp reviewer. The shop is at 1521 3rd St in downtown Napa.

faq.q: How long has the shop been open?
faq.a: Owner San Yankee opened Chateau Barber Shop in June 2005 and celebrated 20 years on June 1, 2025.
